chunks: Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Ahmad, from al-Hasan ibn 'Ali ibn Faddal, from 'Abd Allah ibn Bukayr, from Mu'awiyah ibn Maysarah, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام.
And he mentioned the like of it.

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام, the final authority cited in this report
key_terms.عَنْ: from; used to link narrators in the sanad/isnad
key_terms.مِثْلَهُ: the like of it; meaning a similar wording or ruling to a previous narration
key_terms.وَذَكَرَ: and he mentioned; indicates transmission of a report

ai.seo_question: What does 'وَذَكَرَ مِثْلَهُ' mean in a hadith chain from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This report preserves an isnad to Imam Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام and concludes with a brief reference indicating that he narrated something similar to the preceding report. Its significance lies in corroboration within hadith transmission, especially in the jurisprudential context of waters and the rulings related to taharah (ritual purity).
